comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Does changing `rectData.class !== 'undefined'` to `rectData.class !== undefined` do anything?

To me, it seems like this actually fixes a bug (if so, this should be in the PR description, so we can say something like "TypeScript caught some bad `undefined` handling, so this should now be fixed", then we can consider this PR to be both a bug fix, and a refactoring PR).

~Have we done `e2e` tests to see if something has changed?~ _Edit_: I've tested locally, and the E2E tests don't seem to show any differences, so this should be good!

E.g. something like:

```bash
git clean -fxd cypress/ # warning, will delete old unsaved files in this folder
git switch develop
# run e2e tests on develop, then switch to PR and run e2e tests, comparing with develop snapshots
pnpm install && pnpm run test && pnpm run e2e \
  && git switch Yokozuna59/chore/convert-svgDrawCommon-to-ts \
  && pnpm install && pnpm run test && pnpm run e2e
```
